brief:
Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu characterized a new documentary as "shocking incitement" on Monday, rejecting allegations that mass civilian deaths were systematically incorporated into targeting decisions during operations in Gaza, according to Al-Monitor. The film, titled "NAZA," forms part of what Netanyahu described as a broader wave of global incitement against Israel.

The documentary's claims about civilian casualties in targeting methodology represent a central point of international contention surrounding Gaza operations. Netanyahu's response reflects the Israeli government's broader pushback against documentaries and investigations examining civilian impact during the conflict.

title: Netanyahu denounces Gaza documentary as incitement campaign
